entities.name: Type II secretion protein J
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P31740 from Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris.
Annotated as a membrane component involved in the bacterial type II secretion system.
Predicted Pfam T2SSJ domain PF11612.15 spans residues 30–199.
Length is 211 aa; calculated molecular weight is 22.77 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.74.

entities.name: Type II protein secretion
observations: Protein participates in the type II secretion system complex and protein secretion by the type II secretion system.
